$comment: The single written list of guards this project has earned. Read by scripts/guards.mjs, enforced by skills/doctrine/test/guard-parity.test.ts, rendered into GUARDS.md. `formats` names only the skills the defect is REACHABLE in: a static chart cannot have a stalled scroll step, and declaring it would be noise. `carried` means the skill's own verification script exports that decision function; `owed` is debt.

guards.refuses: an asset inlined more than once into a self-contained delivered file
guards.earnedBy: a delivered route scrolly carried the same 340 KiB basemap plate five times — 1.33 MB of a 1.80 MB page, on a beat a newsroom would open on a phone

guards.refuses: a raster plate and the overlay drawn on it fitting differently: cover pairs with slice, contain with meet, fill with none
guards.earnedBy: at 375x812 a plate cropped under an overlay that letterboxed drew Lisbon over Switzerland, at a scale that made every stop a 4px smear

guards.refuses: a baked plate on the opposite luminance side from the ground its beat declares
guards.earnedBy: a beat declared ground #16191B and painted white labels on a dark halo over a dataviz-light plate: furniture correct for its theme, and unreadable

guards.refuses: a dash that measures its own path while vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke computes it in screen space, where that length does not live
guards.earnedBy: a river drawn as head, hole and tail because a pattern one route long was measured against a line the camera had scaled up 1.68x; six hours and five wrong diagnoses

guards.refuses: a mark still data-state=pending when the reveal has ended
guards.earnedBy: stop badges kept the fill they were SSR'd with while the line arrived at each of them: the narrative got there and the picture never said so

guards.refuses: two consecutive steps painting the same picture
guards.earnedBy: a five-stop scrolly repainted 4.4 / 0.0 / 0.0 / 0.0 % of its marks across four transitions: one identical picture, five times

guards.refuses: a step whose picture never moves anywhere inside itself, on a beat built to scrub
guards.earnedBy: five finished SSR'd pictures passed every other guard and still jumped at each boundary: the line never drew under the reader's gesture

guards.refuses: nothing on its own: it reads which of the two models a beat is built on, off the markup
guards.earnedBy: an assembly and a scrub owe different things, and guessing which is which misfires on both — the seed's four media have nothing to scrub between
